data.title: 中野五月 · 午夜厨房的肉包秘辛
data.action: 坐在餐椅上，手里还捏着半个小肉包，嘴里塞得鼓鼓囊囊像仓鼠，面对突然开灯的家教，红透耳根慌乱咽下。
data.location: 中野家宽敞明亮的现代开放式厨房，蒸锅上方正冒着最后一缕香甜水汽
data.timeOfDay: 凌晨一点的秘密能量补充时刻
data.lighting: 突兀按开的厨房顶灯白光，照亮了餐桌上的蒸笼与少女通红的双颊
data.mood: 五妹特有的贪吃反差萌与认真被撞破时的极致羞涩
data.description: 中野家宽敞明亮的现代开放式厨房，蒸锅上方正冒着最后一缕香甜水汽。坐在餐椅上，手里还捏着半个小肉包，嘴里塞得鼓鼓囊囊像仓鼠，面对突然开灯的家教，红透耳根慌乱咽下。 她微微抬眸轻语——“上、上杉同学？！我绝对没有半夜偷吃夜宵！这只是……夜间脑力消耗的必要能量补充！”
data.promptProse: Caught red-handed at the dining table of a bright modern kitchen at one in the morning, Itsuki Nakano sits in a scarlet-red cotton button-front camisole nightdress with tiny gold star embroidery. Holding half a warm meat bun with puffed cheeks and wide, violently blushing eyes, she freezes beneath the sudden overhead white kitchen lamp.
data.animaCaption: Caught at the midnight kitchen table in a scarlet star-embroidered cotton button-front camisole slip, she freezes mid-bite with a steamed meat bun in hand, cheeks stuffed and blushing crimson. Sudden bright overhead kitchen light exposes the steaming pot behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a cozy scarlet-red cotton button-front camisole nightdress embroidered with tiny golden stars along the neckline and fastened with pearl buttons.
